group:paper-gaokao-2023-four-provinces-f.overview: 文章关注过度捕捞从浅水向深海延伸的危害，以种群锐减、繁殖缓慢和体型变小说明深海鱼的困境，并呼吁兼顾生态保护、渔民生计与粮食安全。
group:paper-gaokao-2023-four-provinces-f.fullTranslationZh:
由于过度捕捞，浅水鱼的数量已严重下降。人们仍然想吃鱼，因此渔业必须寻找其他鱼类来源，尤其是大西洋深水区。这导致许多被捕捞物种的数量急剧下降。

如果要让这些深海鱼存活下来，就必须采取保护措施。对其中五个物种的研究表明，它们的数量下降了87%至98%。这使它们被归入“极度濒危”的类别。如果当前趋势持续下去，许多物种很可能会彻底消失。这些物种已经在我们的海洋里游弋了数亿年。

数量下降发生在不到二十年的时间里，这一事实进一步凸显了问题的严重性。深海鱼需要很长时间才能繁殖，而且通常寿命很长。

不幸的是，它们的繁殖率很低。这类鱼的平均体型也变小了，其中一个物种的平均体型缩小了57%。这一点尤其令人担忧，因为大鱼往往比小鱼繁育更多后代。

渔业没有把这些事实中的任何一点考虑在内。人们一直在捕捞深海物种，仿佛它们是沙丁鱼、鲱鱼那样繁殖迅速的鱼类。这就好比捕杀大象，却把大象当作繁殖速度和兔子一样快的动物。

过度捕捞造成的损害超出了海洋环境的范围。数百万人靠渔业谋生。数十亿人依靠鱼类获取蛋白质。必须采取措施，不仅保护生态系统，还要维持人们的生计并保障粮食安全。

units.summary: 浅水鱼减少推动捕捞转向深海，调查数字说明许多深海物种已面临严重生存危机。

units.heading: 繁殖特点被忽视，种群难以恢复
units.summary: 短期内大量减少与繁殖慢、体型变小叠加，渔业却仍按快速繁殖的鱼类来捕捞。

units.heading: 保护生态，也维护人的生活
units.summary: 过度捕捞同时威胁就业和食物来源，需要采取综合保护措施。

completedSourceTexts.text: There has been a very serious decline in the numbers of shallow-water fish as a result of overfishing. People still want to eat fish, so the fishing industry must look at other sources, especially the deep waters of the Atlantic. This has resulted in a sharp decline in the numbers of many of the species caught.

Conservation measures will have to be put in place if these deep-sea fish are to survive. Research on five such species shows that numbers have declined by between 87 percent and 98 percent. This puts them in the category of “critically endangered”. Many species could well disappear completely if the present trend continues. These are species that have been swimming in our oceans for hundreds of millions of years.
The problem is emphasized by the fact that the decline in numbers happened in less than twenty years. Deep-sea fish take a long time to reproduce and normally live for many years.

Unfortunately, their reproduction rate is very low. The average size of such fish also declined, with one species showing a 57 percent decline in average size. This is of particular concern, as large fish tend to produce more offspring than small ones.

None of these facts has been taken into account by the fishing industry. The deep-sea species have been caught as if they were the fast-breeding (快速繁殖) fish like sardine and herring. It is like killing elephants as if they reproduced at the same rate as rabbits.

The damage done by overfishing goes beyond the sea environment. Millions of people make a living in the fishing industry. Billions of people rely on fish for protein. Measures must be taken to not only conserve ecosystems, but also sustain livelihoods and ensure food security.
